veto_gates.detail: No safety, determinism, contract, or scientific-integrity regression observed.

changes_verified: Leakage taxonomy labels its impact column explicitly as non-ranking and distinguishes scalar transforms from high-impact fitted transforms and selection.
Nested-versus-flat CV optimism is conditional on search size/correlation, signal, and sample size, with report fields specified.
SMOTE guidance states the severe-imbalance regime, removes the unconditional no-AUC-gain claim, and requires original-prevalence evaluation/recalibration.
A TRIPOD+AI-oriented validation-report skeleton specifies split, leakage, discrimination, calibration, utility, subgroup, and provenance fields.
remaining_deductions: Examples still assume well-formed X, y, and groups rather than performing runtime input validation.
The broad SKILL.md remains a single document rather than splitting conditional detail into references.

results: Nested CV versus flat CV: 0.753 +/- 0.030 versus 0.762; the skill now explains why this +0.009 gap is data- and search-dependent.
Pure-noise leakage: selection outside folds 0.904 AUC versus 0.547 inside a Pipeline; taxonomy now prevents its frequency ordering being read as an impact ordering.
Structured CV: 419 scaffold spans under plain folds versus 0 under StratifiedGroupKFold.
Calibration API: sklearn 1.9.1 rejects cv='prefit'; FrozenEstimator and temperature calibration are available.
Utility: quantile reliability bins gave mean absolute gap 0.0596 versus 0.1036 for uniform bins; decision-curve calculations remained coherent.

Resampling: at 24.7% prevalence SMOTE changed AUC 0.783 to 0.810, Brier 0.1480 to 0.1421, and mean risk 0.247 to 0.275; the new text correctly avoids a universal direction claim while preserving the original-prevalence calibration requirement.
LOO/AUC remains degenerate; repeated 5x10 CV ran with 0.667 +/- 0.125. A pooled-versus-fold-average difference of 0.002 does not contradict the skill's narrower non-equivalence warning.

remaining_recommendations: Add explicit input-shape/class-count/group-integrity preflight checks if this guidance becomes a reusable executable validator.
Consider a small references/report-template artifact only if report generation becomes a recurring workflow; the inline skeleton resolves the audited missing deliverable.
